name: a1_test01
description: The roads A1 drove in its TEST-01 run, as one legal lane chain: road 1 lane 1 (A1's spawn) through road 8 and road 4, straight through junction 468, onto road 5 lane -1 where A1's 120 s run ended.
source: docs/evidence/TEST-01-samples.csv: first and last logged actor positions; lanes matched to A1's logged poses with a direction-consistent nearest-lane search
notes: A1 changed lanes between lanes 1 and 2 on road 1 and between lanes -2 and -1 on road 5. A2 has no lane-change manoeuvre, so it keeps lane 1 / lane -1, which are A1's start and end lanes.
obstacle_note: S1-S4 obstacles go mid-way along the 125 m straight (s 65-190 m). Road 1 starts with a 62 m bend at about 45 degrees to the map axes, where the track filter's axis-aligned footprint box widens roadside cars into the lane (harness: S3 held, S1 stopped 6.17 m short). S5 still uses the junction exit.
